q.line: The angel Moroni asleep in the carport
stanza: The angel Moroni asleep in the carport
With the newspaper under his arm
It seems I was late to deliver his car keys
So it looks like we are staying behind
Was Lucifer bashful in hiding his face from the Lord
Dear Jesus, forgive me, I am only doing as I was told

partner.line: Was Lucifer bashful in hiding his face from the Lord
